notes.title: TIME TO SAY GOODBYE
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
After many months, I come back to you to give you two messages: good and bad. Let's start with the bad one.

For technical reasons related to the loss of all "Flame of Memory" project files, the game can no longer be developed. It is likely that the sale will be completed shortly and it will no longer be possible to buy it. I'm glad that some of you like this game. The people who bought it will still be able to play it from what I know. However, this is the end of bad news.

As a game developer, I want to grow all the time. Some time ago, together with my friend, we started the production of our common computer game called "Beekeeper". It is an economic strategy based on running your own apiary. If you are interested in this project, you can go to its website in the Steam Store.

The premiere of the game in the Early Access version should take place soon.

I hope you will understand this situation. You are the best!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - FLAME OF MEMORY
notes.content:
New features:
- new GUI style
- clear system  of hints, just one click when you do not know what you should do now
- experience system
- skills tree
- bug fixes
- new soundtrack and sounds
- and more!
